data.name: CueTh
data.value: Rest the tip of your tongue lightly between your teeth and let air flow out.

data.name: CueVoicedTh
data.value: Rest your tongue tip between your teeth and add voice as the air flows out.

data.name: CueKit
data.value: Relax the corners of your mouth and keep the vowel short.

data.name: CueFleece
data.value: Raise the front of your tongue towards the hard palate and keep the vowel clear.

data.name: CueTrap
data.value: Open your jaw a little more and keep your tongue forward.

data.name: CueNurse
data.value: Keep your tongue in the middle of your mouth and sustain the vowel steadily.

data.name: CuePalm
data.value: Open your jaw, draw your tongue back and lengthen the vowel.

data.name: CueLot
data.value: Round your lips slightly and make a short vowel at the back of your mouth.

data.name: CueGoat
data.value: Glide from a central vowel towards /ʊ/, gradually rounding your lips.

data.name: CueL
data.value: Touch the ridge behind your upper teeth with your tongue tip and let air pass around its sides.

data.name: CueR
data.value: Draw your tongue slightly back, leaving a gap between its tip and the ridge behind your upper teeth.

data.name: CueV
data.value: Touch your lower lip lightly with your upper teeth and add voice as the air passes through.

data.name: CueF
data.value: Touch your lower lip lightly with your upper teeth and let the air flow steadily.

data.name: CueW
data.value: Round your lips, then glide into the following vowel.

data.name: CueS
data.value: Bring your tongue close to the ridge behind your upper teeth and direct air along its centre.

data.name: CueZ
data.value: Bring your tongue close to the ridge behind your upper teeth. Keep the air flowing and add voice.

data.name: CueSh
data.value: Raise your tongue just behind the ridge above your upper teeth and round your lips slightly.

data.name: CueNg
data.value: Lift the back of your tongue to your soft palate and let air pass through your nose.

data.name: CueGeneral
data.value: Listen to the word on its own, then practise it in the sentence.
